competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may refer to an exchange window, store credit, a previous policy version, or a special category rather than the current full-refund window for standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
predicted_outcome: H_P is true: the correct current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, is not a full refund, or applies only to a different item category or condition.
